title: AIRLIFT
frontText:
RATIONED EVENT
AIRLIFT
Move any 1 pawn to any location.
Get permission before moving another player's pawn.
The havens' last remaining plane is held together with bailing wire, but we're still able to get it off the ground about once a month.
Play at any time. Not an action.
